sources.entry: gradio - Build and share machine learning apps, all in Python.

summary.one_liner: Gradio is an open-source Python package that turns a machine learning model, API, or any Python function into a web demo or app, with an option to share it via a public link.
summary.what_it_does: Wraps any Python function in a web UI using the gr.Interface class, given input and output components such as textboxes, sliders, images and HTML. The gr.Blocks class offers a lower-level way to control layout, multi-step data flows, and component visibility or properties in Python. gr.ChatInterface builds chatbot UIs from a single function. Setting share=True in launch() generates a public URL while computation keeps running on the local machine. The README also describes related pieces: a Python client (gradio_client), a JavaScript client (@gradio/client), Hugging Face Spaces hosting, and a gradio.Server mode for custom frontends. It also provides a hot reload command (gradio app.py) and an optional in-browser vibe mode, plus a "skill" for AI coding assistants.
use_cases: build a web demo for a machine learning model
wrap a Python function in a simple UI
share a model demo with a public link
build custom multi-component apps with layouts
query a Gradio app from Python or JavaScript
how_to_run: Save the example code as app.py
python app.py  (or: gradio app.py for hot reload)
Set demo.launch(share=True) to get a public URL
notable: Builds a demo from a plain Python function in a few lines, with no JavaScript or CSS required
share=True creates a public link while the model runs on your own machine
Offers both a high-level Interface class and a low-level Blocks class for custom layouts
Includes Python and JavaScript client libraries for querying any Gradio app
Has a hot reload mode and an in-browser vibe mode for writing apps with natural language
caveats: Public share links depend on Gradio's sharing feature; the README gives no details on limits or duration
Hosting on Hugging Face Spaces is described as free, but no other hosting details are given
